title: Verify the direct inspection request policy

context.hint: Enforce the configured request policy through every API inspection entry point.
context.surface: An API inspection engine can probe operations directly or through an API description.
assumptions: Use a disposable local HTTP server with synthetic state.

review.invariant: Default direct inspection sends only operations permitted by the read-only policy.
review.verification: Record requests and state on a local fixture during default inspection. Confirm that a read succeeds, disallowed operations are absent, and state survives. Compare an explicitly enabled state-changing mode.

source_observation.summary: The original direct sweep changed local fixture state. The repair preserved state by default while retaining explicitly enabled operations. The fixture used real local HTTP requests.
